description: This file defines API routes for managing seeded memory match card games using FastAPI. It includes data models for requests and responses, route handler functions for creating games, retrieving decks, and matching cards, and integrates with a backend service for game logic. The routes are documented with OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: CreateGameRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new seeded game session, including optional difficulty and seed.

classes.name: CreateGameResponse
classes.description: Response model containing details about the created game and deck metadata.

classes.name: Card
classes.description: Model representing a card in the deck, with id and face value.

classes.name: MatchRequest
classes.description: Model for requesting a match attempt between two card IDs.

classes.name: MatchResponse
classes.description: Result of a match attempt, indicating success and game status.

methods.name: CreateGameResponse create_game(payload: CreateGameRequest = Body(default=CreateGameRequest()))
methods.description: API handler to create a new seeded game, returning game info and deck details.

methods.name: List[Card] get_deck(gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Game session ID"))
methods.description: API handler to retrieve the current visible deck of a specific game.

methods.name: MatchResponse post_match( gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Game session ID"), payload: MatchRequest = Body(...), )
methods.description: API handler to attempt matching two cards in a game, updating game state.
